The Router correctly identified the failure of linear alignment and functional component definition (magazine well, ejection port). artifact_review: The Router correctly identified critical artifacts: fusion at the receiver/handguard interface (Severity 4), structural collapse of the scope mount (Severity 4), and text gibberish (Severity 5). The 'extra_limbs' artifact (floating part) is also correctly identified (Severity 3). The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these because they are structural/semantic, not just graphic distortions. The Text Auditor found 'B0000900' with low confidence, confirming the gibberish nature. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.97) is misleading; it simply means the AI generated a coherent *shape* of a gun, but fails to capture the internal topological correctness (holes, gaps, distinct parts). The severity ratings are appropriate, with the text and structural failures being catastrophic for a mechanical object.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine-Grained Classifier correctly identifies the class as 'assault rifle' (Top-1), indicating the global semantic content is correct. However, only 2 out of 9 diagnostic checkpoints passed (Length proportion and Finish tone). The core defining features of an assault rifle—linear alignment, distinct receiver/barrel/stock separation, functional magazine well, and proper optic mounting—are all structurally failed or fused. The image represents a 'gun-like' shape but lacks the precise mechanical conformance required for a high alignment score. It is significantly worse than the high-quality reference (000380) and closer to the low-quality references due to structural incoherence.
